class.name: MaszynaMoverRailVehicleDieselEngine
class.description: [RailVehicleDieselEngine] simulated by the vendored Mover ([code]TMoverParameters[/code]): its configuration is written into the vehicle's Mover and its live values are read straight from it. Created by the FIZ import for a vehicle [MaszynaMoverVehicleServer] simulates; everything else reaches it through [RailVehicleDieselEngine].

method.name: get_clutch_desired
method.description: The clutch engagement the master controller's position asks for ([code]RList[lb]MainCtrlPos[rb].Mn[/code]).

method.name: get_eimic_real
method.description: The traction an EIM controller actually asks for, -1-1 ([code]eimic_real[/code]).

members.member: What the Mover's model of the diesel engine is configured with.
What the Mover's model of the engine is configured with beyond its facts, read by the drive.
